hardware.scope: Search uses one native query at a time. Embedding preparation uses MPS and runs before search timing.

measurement.query_time: routing plus native index search; embedding excluded
measurement.recall: Recall of exact binary-score neighbors for that fixed dimension; not human relevance or agreement with the full float embedding.

archived_summary_snapshots.scope: Historical summary; not added to final setting counts.

runtime.scope: Worker durations count each(pid,started_at) once, including archived attempts. Command logs and worker durations overlap and are not added. Some manual commands are absent from command logs. First-to-last worker span includes pauses and intervening preparation. No complete project-start-to-finish clock was recorded.

probability.scope: Within B only; all three declared seeds are included. Selected-point repeats do not replace this all-seed view.
